morbi.headline: Morbi faces operational stress with unit shutdowns, high inventory, and rising fuel costs
what_changed: Morbi ceramic production cycle slowed down, resulting in full warehouses of unsold stock and 15% of units shutting down
Attempts to mitigate or control elevated propane gas prices have failed, increasing operational challenges
Proposed ceramic testing laboratory for Bikaner's 200 clay mines is being relocated to Jaipur due to building possession delays

Rising propane gas prices remain uncontrolled, straining operational costs for cluster units [64076d83f199]
what_to_watch: Inventory liquidation trends and warehouse stock levels across ceramic manufacturing accounts

Operational continuity and capacity utilization metrics to identify further potential unit closures

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe textile cost shocks and labor agitation amid diamond sector resilience.
what_changed: Surat textile trade dropped 50% due to doubled coal prices and a 66% surge in yarn prices [16a5b570eb9e, b62552cc0c7d].
Diamond industry shortened its traditional Diwali vacation and experienced a demand boom [2b47ff4fa01a, ff0f473e0921].
Textile weavers moved to a two-day weekly holiday alongside mandatory 15-day yarn payment rules ahead of Diwali [0c72a246c955].
stress_signals: Textile industry hit by recessionary pressures ahead of Diwali and ₹15.57 crore textile fraud detected [28ff6df05700, cf2229091691].
Intense labor agitations, 'Gaon Chalo' protests, and leave disputes among textile and embroidery workers [6b7974c7f88e, 73dfcce5d3f4, a9383cbae2cf].
Fire incidents reported at a textile and yarn unit in Pipodara GIDC and a diamond premises [42bc4e18e52d, 8103ae8facb8].
improvement_signals: Diamond boom raising hopes of worker wage cut rollbacks and shortened Diwali vacation duration [ff0f473e0921, 2b47ff4fa01a].
Surat-made fabric-coated balloon airship successfully tested for high-altitude border surveillance [5a6c6ad01d9d].
Establishment of ICA-GemLab and MANTRA reinforcing Surat's status as a global testing hub [26bd1ecd549c, 0b9a805766c6].
what_to_watch: Monitor cash flow compression and working capital utilization in upstream weaving and processing units facing severe input cost spikes [16a5b570eb9e, b62552cc0c7d].
Track compliance with TSRS portal returns and FOSTTA advisories regarding new agents [6b6e98ad9c2d, 9013ae33515c].
Observe labor relations and potential absenteeism post-Diwali exodus [b0d8a5269e4e, a9383cbae2cf].
